import system

	index = self.props.value
	now = system.date.now()
	
	# Base: hoy a las 06:00
	start_day = system.date.setTime(now, 6, 0, 0)
	
	start_date = start_day
	end_date = start_day
	
	# Helpers
	year = system.date.getYear(now)
	month = system.date.getMonth(now)
	
	if index == 0:  # Current day
	    start_date = start_day
	    end_date = system.date.addDays(start_date, 1)
	
	elif index == 1:  # Yesterday
	    start_date = system.date.addDays(start_day, -1)
	    end_date = system.date.addDays(start_date, 1)
	
	elif index == 2:  # Current Week (lunes inicio)
	    dow = system.date.getDayOfWeek(start_day)  # 1=Sunday
	    offset = -(dow - 2) if dow != 1 else -6
	    start_date = system.date.addDays(start_day, offset)
	    end_date = system.date.addDays(start_date, 7)
	
	elif index == 3:  # Last Week
	    dow = system.date.getDayOfWeek(start_day)
	    offset = -(dow - 2) if dow != 1 else -6
	    this_week_start = system.date.addDays(start_day, offset)
	    start_date = system.date.addDays(this_week_start, -7)
	    end_date = system.date.addDays(start_date, 7)
	
	elif index == 4:  # Current month
	    start_date = system.date.setTime(
	        system.date.getDate(year, month, 1),
	        6, 0, 0
	    )
	    end_date = system.date.addMonths(start_date, 1)
	
	elif index == 5:  # Last month
	    first_this_month = system.date.getDate(year, month, 1)
	    start_date = system.date.setTime(
	        system.date.addMonths(first_this_month, -1),
	        6, 0, 0
	    )
	    end_date = system.date.setTime(first_this_month, 6, 0, 0)
	
	elif index == 6:  # Current year to date
	    start_date = system.date.setTime(
	        system.date.getDate(year, 0, 1),
	        6, 0, 0
	    )
	    end_date = system.date.addDays(start_day, 1)
	
	elif index == 7:  # Shift 1 (6-14)
	    start_date = system.date.setTime(now, 6, 0, 0)
	    end_date = system.date.setTime(now, 14, 0, 0)
	
	elif index == 8:  # Shift 2 (14-22)
	    start_date = system.date.setTime(now, 14, 0, 0)
	    end_date = system.date.setTime(now, 22, 0, 0)
	
	elif index == 9:  # Shift 3 (22-6)
	    start_date = system.date.setTime(now, 22, 0, 0)
	    end_date = system.date.addDays(
	        system.date.setTime(now, 6, 0, 0), 1
	    )
	
	elif index == -1:  # Custom
	    system.perspective.print("Custom")
	
	else:  # Default current month
	    start_date = system.date.setTime(
	        system.date.getDate(year, month, 1),
	        6, 0, 0
	    )
	    end_date = system.date.addMonths(start_date, 1)
	
	# Asignar
	if index != -1:
	    self.view.params.startDate = start_date
	    self.view.params.endDate = end_date

import system

	view = self.view
	
	start = view.params.startDate
	end = view.params.endDate
	
	# Validar nulls
	if start is None or end is None:
	    return
	
	# Obtener valores del spinner
	container = self.parent
	amount = container.getChild("NumericEntryField").props.value
	unit = container.getChild("Dropdown").props.value
	
	# Multiplicador negativo (izquierda)
	amount = -amount
	
	# Aplicar desplazamiento
	if unit == 0:  # Hour
	    start = system.date.addHours(start, amount)
	    end = system.date.addHours(end, amount)
	
	elif unit == 1:  # Day
	    start = system.date.addDays(start, amount)
	    end = system.date.addDays(end, amount)
	
	elif unit == 2:  # Week
	    start = system.date.addWeeks(start, amount)
	    end = system.date.addWeeks(end, amount)
	
	elif unit == 3:  # Month
	    start = system.date.addMonths(start, amount)
	    end = system.date.addMonths(end, amount)
	
	elif unit == 4:  # Year
	    start = system.date.addYears(start, amount)
	    end = system.date.addYears(end, amount)
	
	# Asignar
	view.params.startDate = start
	view.params.endDate = end
	
	# Opcional: forzar custom
	view.params.dateRangePeriodIndex = -1

	if start is None or end is None:

	container = self.parent

	unit = container.getChild("Dropdown").props.value
	
	# Aplicar desplazamiento positivo
	if unit == 0:  # Hour
	    start = system.date.addHours(start, amount)

	elif unit == 1:  # Day
	    start = system.date.addDays(start, amount)
	    end = system.date.addDays(end, amount)
	
	elif unit == 2:  # Week
	    start = system.date.addWeeks(start, amount)
	    end = system.date.addWeeks(end, amount)
	
	elif unit == 3:  # Month
	    start = system.date.addMonths(start, amount)
	    end = system.date.addMonths(end, amount)
	
	elif unit == 4:  # Year
	    start = system.date.addYears(start, amount)
